The '''Senate Hearing Chamber''' was a large governmental hearing chamber located within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Galactic Senate Building]] on the galactic capital world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Smaller than the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Galactic Senate Chamber]], the Senate Hearing Chamber boasted 20 tiers, [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpods]] for several hundred [[Senator/Legends|senators]], and seating for news correspondents and onlookers. As some beings observed, the chamber, due to the nature of the kinds of meetings that were generally held there, was not normally packed with overflow crowds. Senate Hearing Chamber meetings were usually "so dull," according to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], that "no one attended them."<ref name="JQ:TFP" />

On occasion, however, such as occurred in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], when a sensationalist hearing [[Attack on the Senate Building|took place]] that heard witnesses testify against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for alleged abuses against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], filling the pods, seats and tier aisles, beyond the Senators and their [[Senatorial aide|aides]], were officials of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news and curious Coruscant natives. Kenobi, accustomed to rather something different for this space, was therefore quite surprised at the turnout.<ref name="JQ:TFP" />
